record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Can one construct rational two-dimensional conformal field theories satisfying the Kontsevich, Segal, and Moore-Seiberg axioms, or at least prove that such theories exist, including Wess-Zumino-Witten models and minimal models? A complete construction should include higher-genus correlation functions and a locally convex complete topological state space with a nondegenerate Hermitian form, rather than only genus-zero and genus-one data or a graded state space.

evidence.quote: Problem 2.1. Construct rational conformal field theories satisfying the axioms of Kontsevich, G. Segal [Se] and Moore-Seiberg [MS1] [MS2], or at least prove the existence of such rational conformal field theories. In particular, construct the Wess-Zumino-Witten models and minimal models or at least prove their existence.

But there is still no construction of the higher-genus correlation functions. Also, the state space obtained in these constructions is only a graded space with a nondegenerate symmetric bilinear or Hermitian form. To construct the conformal field theories completely, we also need to construct a locally convex complete topological vector space with a nondegenerate Hermitian form.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Construct, or at least prove the existence of, rational two-dimensional conformal field theories satisfying the axioms of Kontsevich, Segal, and Moore–Seiberg. Concretely:

(a) Specify a state space H that is a locally convex, complete topological vector space equipped with a nondegenerate Hermitian form (not merely a graded vector space with a symmetric bilinear or Hermitian form).

(b) Construct correlation functions on Riemann surfaces of arbitrary genus with marked points and local coordinates, valued in suitable tensor powers of H, satisfying:
  (i) the conformal/diffeomorphism covariance and modular invariance properties prescribed by the Segal/Kontsevich functorial axioms (functoriality with respect to gluing of Riemann surfaces along boundary circles);
  (ii) the Moore–Seiberg consistency conditions for chiral data, including duality, modular transformation, and factorization on all genera.

(c) Carry out this construction explicitly (or prove existence) in the two principal families of examples: the Wess–Zumino–Witten models associated with a compact simple Lie group at positive integer level, and the Virasoro minimal models.

In particular, produce the higher-genus (g ≥ 2) correlation functions for these theories, going beyond the genus-zero and genus-one data currently available, in such a way that the full system of correlators arises by gluing from the Segal/Kontsevich functor on the category of Riemann surface cobordisms.
artifact.category_tag: Rational conformal field theory / Segal axioms
artifact.status_search_result: Genus-zero and genus-one correlation functions have been constructed for rational CFTs (including WZW and minimal models) via vertex operator algebra and modular tensor category methods, and full classification of rational full CFTs on all-genus cobordisms exists at the level of topological/algebraic data (Fuchs–Runkel–Schweigert and related work). However, an analytic construction of higher-genus correlation functions on a locally convex complete topological state space with a nondegenerate Hermitian form, fulfilling the Segal/Kontsevich axioms in full, has not been carried out for WZW or minimal models. Recent rigorous Segal-axiom verifications exist for free fields, φ^4_2, and Liouville CFT, but not for the rational models in question. The problem is therefore partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Segal's axioms and bootstrap for Liouville Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Verification of Segal's axioms for Liouville conformal field theory.
status_evidence.claim: Segal's axioms have been rigorously verified for Liouville CFT, but rigorous verification for WZW/minimal models at all genera is still lacking.

status_evidence.title: Conformal field theory in nLab
status_evidence.snippet: Classification of rational full 2d CFT via Frobenius algebras in modular tensor categories on cobordisms of all genera (Fuchs-Runkel-Schweigert).
status_evidence.claim: Algebraic/topological classification of rational full CFTs exists, but the analytic Segal-functor construction is incomplete.
